# Tools Reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-tool-docs.mjs. Run npm run docs:generate; do not edit directly. -->

The full profile exposes **87 tools**; the essential profile exposes **25 tools**. This reference is generated from the registered input/output schemas and behavior annotations.

Set `OPENCODE_TOOL_PROFILE=essential` for the smaller catalog; `full` is the default. Profile availability is listed for each tool. Profiles control discovery, not OpenCode permissions.

## Input and Output Contracts

When present, `directory` means an absolute path on the OpenCode server. Global authentication tools omit it; local project initialization uses `path`. See [configuration](configuration.md) for scope and [examples](examples.md) for workflows.

Results retain readable MCP `content` and provide `structuredContent`. Structured outputs include `text` and `isError`; generic JSON lives in `data`, while async tools provide identifiers and state fields. Tool errors also set the MCP result's `isError`. Inspect state rather than parsing text. An observation timeout can return a running state without an error or cancellation.

Async states are `accepted`, `running`, `input_required`, `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled`, and `unknown`. Native MCP task execution is negotiated separately from ordinary tool calls. See [architecture](architecture.md).

Annotations are behavior hints, not an authorization boundary. Nested structures and constraints are included in each tool's expandable JSON schema.

## Workflow Tools

### `opencode_ask`

Ask OpenCode a question in one step. Creates a new session, sends your prompt, and returns the AI response. This is the easiest way to interact with OpenCode.

**Profiles:** full, essential.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: true`, `idempotentHint: false`, `openWorldHint: true`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes | The question or instruction to send |
| `title` | string | no | Optional title for the session |
| `providerID` | string | no | Provider ID (e.g. 'anthropic') |
| `modelID` | string | no | Model ID (e.g. 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022') |
| `variant` | string | no | Model variant (e.g. 'fast', 'smart') |
| `agent` | string | no | Agent to use (e.g. 'build', 'plan') |
| `system` | string | no | Optional system prompt override |
| `format` | object \| object | no | Response format: plain text or JSON constrained by a JSON Schema. |
| `directory` | string | no | Absolute path to the project directory. When provided, the request targets that project. If omitted, the OpenCode server uses its own working directory. |

#### Structured output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes |  |
| `isError` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data` | unknown | no |  |

### `opencode_check`

Get current task status, pending input, todos and file counts. Uses session summary metadata instead of fetching patches. Pass jobId for exact durable turn correlation; detailed includes response text.

**Profiles:** full, essential.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: true`, `openWorldHint: true`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sessionId` | string | no | Session ID (required unless jobId is supplied) |
| `jobId` | string | no | Durable job ID |
| `messageId` | string | no | Submitted user message ID to correlate |
| `detailed` | boolean | no | Include response text (default false) |
| `directory` | string | no | Absolute path to the project directory. When provided, the request targets that project. If omitted, the OpenCode server uses its own working directory. |

#### Structured output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes |  |
| `isError` | boolean | yes |  |
| `sessionId` | string | no |  |
| `jobId` | string | no |  |
| `messageId` | string | no |  |
| `directory` | string | no |  |
| `status` | "accepted" \| "running" \| "input_required" \| "completed" \| "failed" \| "cancelled" \| "unknown" | yes |  |
| `result` | unknown | no |  |
| `error` | unknown | no |  |

### `opencode_fire`

Dispatch a durable background task and return its job, session and message IDs immediately. Use opencode_check or opencode_wait to observe; job_cancel stops the task.

**Profiles:** full, essential.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: true`, `idempotentHint: false`, `openWorldHint: true`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes | Task or instruction to send to OpenCode; minimum length: 1 |
| `sessionId` | string | no | Existing session to continue; omit to create one |
| `title` | string | no | Title for a new session |
| `providerID` | string | no | Provider ID from provider discovery |
| `modelID` | string | no | Model ID from provider discovery |
| `variant` | string | no | Model variant |
| `agent` | string | no | OpenCode agent name |
| `directory` | string | no | Absolute path to the project directory. When provided, the request targets that project. If omitted, the OpenCode server uses its own working directory. |
| `format` | object \| object | no | Response format: plain text or JSON constrained by a JSON Schema. |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `isError` | boolean | yes |  |
| `sessionId` | string | no |  |
| `jobId` | string | no |  |
| `messageId` | string | no |  |
| `directory` | string | no |  |
| `status` | "accepted" \| "running" \| "input_required" \| "completed" \| "failed" \| "cancelled" \| "unknown" | yes |  |

| `error` | unknown | no |  |

### `opencode_provider_test`

Quick-test whether a provider is working. Creates a temporary session, sends a trivial prompt, checks the response, and cleans up. Great for debugging auth issues.

**Profiles:** full.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: true`, `idempotentHint: false`, `openWorldHint: true`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `providerId` | string | yes | Provider ID to test (e.g. 'anthropic', 'openrouter') |
| `modelID` | string | no | Specific model ID to test. If omitted, discovers the provider default or first available model. |
| `variant` | string | no | Model variant |
| `format` | object \| object | no | Response format: plain text or JSON constrained by a JSON Schema. |
| `directory` | string | no | Absolute path to the project directory. When provided, the request targets that project. If omitted, the OpenCode server uses its own working directory. |

|---|---|---|---|

| `data` | unknown | no |  |

### `opencode_run`

Send a task and wait for its correlated response. Returns a durable job ID; an observation timeout leaves the remote job running and can be resumed with opencode_wait.

**Profiles:** full, essential.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: true`, `idempotentHint: false`, `openWorldHint: true`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes | Task or instruction to send to OpenCode; minimum length: 1 |
| `sessionId` | string | no | Existing session to continue; omit to create one |
| `title` | string | no | Title for a new session |
| `providerID` | string | no | Provider ID from provider discovery |
| `modelID` | string | no | Model ID from provider discovery |
| `variant` | string | no | Model variant |
| `agent` | string | no | OpenCode agent name |
| `directory` | string | no | Absolute path to the project directory. When provided, the request targets that project. If omitted, the OpenCode server uses its own working directory. |
| `format` | object \| object | no | Response format: plain text or JSON constrained by a JSON Schema. |
| `maxDurationSeconds` | number | no | Maximum observation duration in seconds (default 600); timeout does not abort the job; maximum: 3600 |

### `opencode_wait`

Wait for a session or durable job. Returns completed, failed, input_required, or a resumable timeout. Cancelling this wait stops observation; use job_cancel or session_abort to stop OpenCode.

**Profiles:** full, essential.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: true`, `openWorldHint: true`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sessionId` | string | no | Session ID (required unless jobId is supplied) |
| `jobId` | string | no | Durable job ID returned by opencode_fire or opencode_run |
| `messageId` | string | no | Submitted user message ID to correlate the exact response |
| `timeoutSeconds` | number | no | Maximum seconds to wait (default 120); timeout is resumable; minimum: 0; maximum: 86400 |
| `pollIntervalMs` | integer | no | Polling interval in milliseconds (default 2000); minimum: 10; maximum: 60000 |
| `directory` | string | no | Absolute path to the project directory. When provided, the request targets that project. If omitted, the OpenCode server uses its own working directory. |

### `opencode_session_permission`

Respond to a permission request in a session. Use `opencode_permission_list` to see pending requests. Reply values: 'once' (approve this request only), 'always' (approve this + future matching requests for this session), 'reject' (deny the request).

**Profiles:** full, essential.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: true`, `idempotentHint: false`, `openWorldHint: true`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Session ID |
| `permissionID` | string | yes | Permission request ID |
| `reply` | "once" \| "always" \| "reject" | yes | Response to the permission request: 'once' to approve once, 'always' to auto-approve matching future requests, 'reject' to deny |
| `directory` | string | no | Absolute path to the project directory. When provided, the request targets that project. If omitted, the OpenCode server uses its own working directory. |

#### Structured output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes |  |
| `isError` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data` | unknown | no |  |

  "inputSchema": {
    "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "id": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Session ID"
      },
      "permissionID": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Permission request ID"
      },
      "reply": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "once",
          "always",
          "reject"
        ],
        "description": "Response to the permission request: 'once' to approve once, 'always' to auto-approve matching future requests, 'reject' to deny"
      },
      "directory": {
        "description": "Absolute path to the project directory. When provided, the request targets that project. If omitted, the OpenCode server uses its own working directory.",
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "id",
      "permissionID",
      "reply"
    ],
    "additionalProperties": false
  },
  "outputSchema": {
    "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {

      },

        "type": "boolean"

### `opencode_project_init`

Use this to create new empty folders, or to explicitly open preexisting projects on the MCP host machine for parallel code generation workloads. ## Event Tools

### `opencode_events_poll`

Poll project events from OpenCode, or explicitly select global scope. Collects up to maxEvents within the duration. Connection failures are reported with any partial events; stopping observation does not abort remote work.

**Profiles:** full.

**Annotations:** `readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`, `idempotentHint: true`, `openWorldHint: true`.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `durationMs` | integer | no | How long to collect events in milliseconds (default: 3000, max: 30000); minimum: 1; maximum: 30000 |
| `maxEvents` | integer | no | Maximum number of events to collect (default: 50, max: 1000); minimum: 1; maximum: 1000 |
| `directory` | string | no | Absolute path to the project directory. When provided, the request targets that project. If omitted, the OpenCode server uses its own working directory. |
| `scope` | "project" \| "global" | no | Event scope (default: project). Global events include all projects and cannot be combined with directory. |

#### Structured output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes |  |
| `isError` | boolean | yes |  |
| `data` | unknown | no |  |

<details>
<summary>Complete input and output JSON schemas</summary>

```json
{
  "inputSchema": {
    "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "durationMs": {
        "description": "How long to collect events in milliseconds (default: 3000, max: 30000)",
        "type": "integer",
        "minimum": 1,
        "maximum": 30000
      },
      "maxEvents": {
        "description": "Maximum number of events to collect (default: 50, max: 1000)",
        "type": "integer",
        "minimum": 1,
        "maximum": 1000
      },
      "directory": {
        "description": "Absolute path to the project directory. When provided, the request targets that project. If omitted, the OpenCode server uses its own working directory.",
        "type": "string"
      },
      "scope": {
        "description": "Event scope (default: project). Global events include all projects and cannot be combined with directory.",
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "project",
          "global"
        ]
      }
    },
    "additionalProperties": false
  },
  "outputSchema": {
    "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "text": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "isError": {
        "type": "boolean"
      },
      "data": {}
    },
    "required": [
      "text",
      "isError"
    ],
    "additionalProperties": {}
  }
}
```

</details>
